rationale: The assistant correctly identified 4C as a water supply fault and guided the customer to the closed isolation valve. It was slower than ideal: it told them to leave the valve off while unscrewing the hose and cleaning the filter before opening it, and it never advised isolating power before the filter work. It also raised an 'anti-flood state' check and ignored the customer's question about it, and the closing message did not explain the valve cause or acknowledge the customer's question. No parts were recommended and the issue was resolved.
